description: This Java class 'DefaultAmqp091Config' implements the 'Amqp091Config' interface, providing configuration handling for AMQP 0.9.1 protocol settings, specifically managing 'publisherPendingAckTTL' duration. It includes methods for instantiation based on external Config, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultAmqp091Config
classes.description: Immutable class implementing AMQP 0.9.1 configuration, particularly 'publisherPendingAckTTL'.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method creating an instance from a Config object.

methods.name: getPublisherPendingAckTTL
methods.description: Returns the publisher pending acknowledgment TTL duration.

methods.description: Returns string representation of the configuration object.
